meta.description: Orchestrate an end-to-end de novo protein binder design campaign against a protein target by composing BioNeMo NIM skills. Use for binder design, minibinder design, de novo binders, RFdiffusion + ProteinMPNN + Boltz2/OpenFold3 pipelines, epitope/hotspot-targeted design, in-silico binder validation, and ranking designs by interface confidence.

functional_suitability.note: Complete end-to-end binder design pipeline with 6 stages (prep, backbones, sequences, co-fold, self-consistency, filter/rank); all handoff contracts documented; controls and validation framework included

reliability.note: Strong validation framework with negative controls and success rate reporting; manifest-based reproducibility; minor: no guidance on handling partial campaign failures (e.g., 80% co-folds succeed, 20% fail)

performance_context.note: Exceptional efficiency: 116-line SKILL.md with delegation to 4 atomic skills and 5 reference files plus 6 scripts; clear orchestration layer without duplicating per-NIM details

agent_usability.note: Excellent composed-skill architecture with handoff contract table; cost funnel guidance (co-fold shortlist first); minor: NIM_MODEL_PROFILE gotcha mentioned inline but not integrated into workflow

human_usability.note: Clear human-in-the-loop confirmation points; cost transparency (co-folding expensive); responsible use section with dual-use awareness; default filters documented upfront

security.note: Explicit responsible use section declining pathogen/toxin/bioweapon requests; credentials read from env with no hardcoding; dual-use awareness built into skill design

maintainability.note: Clean orchestration layer with manifest-based reproducibility; scripts externalized for testability; composed-skill architecture allows per-NIM updates without touching orchestration

agent_specific.note: Excellent trigger precision; perfect composability via 4 atomic skills with clear delegation; manifest.json enables resumability and validation; lacks explicit idempotency statement; handoff contracts table exemplary

key_strengths: Exceptional orchestration architecture: clear separation between orchestration layer (this skill) and atomic NIMs with handoff contracts table
Manifest-based reproducibility: manifest.json captures lineage, params, scores, artifacts, and filter status enabling validation and resumability
Strong responsible use framework: explicit dual-use awareness with declination criteria for pathogen/toxin/bioweapon designs
Comprehensive validation: negative controls, success rate reporting, and benchmark target registry with illustrative epitopes
Cost transparency: human-in-the-loop confirmation points and shortlist-before-expansion strategy for expensive co-folding stage

recommendations.title: Add hotspot validation step in target prep
recommendations.problem: Epitope remapping tool documented but no validation that mapped hotspot indices exist in target structure before RFdiffusion call
recommendations.root_cause: Assumes remapping always produces valid indices; out-of-range errors discovered late
recommendations.fix: Add to Pipeline step 1 after epitope mapping: 'Validation: verify all hotspot_res indices exist in target chain (check against scripts/pdb_utils.py:get_sequence length). RFdiffusion will fail on out-of-range hotspots; catch this in prep stage with clear error message showing valid residue range.'

recommendations.title: Integrate NIM_MODEL_PROFILE check into pre-flight
recommendations.problem: NIM_MODEL_PROFILE gotcha documented inline but not in human-in-the-loop confirmation checklist
recommendations.root_cause: Local NIM setup complexity scattered; profile requirement not elevated to pre-flight
recommendations.fix: Add to Human-in-the-loop section: 'For local mode: confirm NIM_MODEL_PROFILE pinned for Boltz2 on GPUs without bundled profile (check references/local-nim-setup.md). Verify with docker ps that Boltz2 container started successfully before launching campaign.'

recommendations.title: Add partial campaign failure handling guidance
recommendations.problem: No guidance on handling scenarios where 80% of co-folds succeed but 20% fail (timeout, memory, malformed input)
recommendations.root_cause: Assumes all-or-nothing campaign success; partial failure common in large campaigns
recommendations.fix: Add to Pipeline after step 4: 'Partial failures: if some co-folds fail (timeout, OOM, bad PDB), manifest tracks status per candidate. Continue with successful subset; investigate failures via logs. Re-run failed subset with adjusted parameters (reduce diffusion_samples, shorter sequences) rather than restarting entire campaign.'

recommendations.title: Add idempotency statement for campaign resumability
recommendations.problem: Manifest enables resumability but determinism of each stage not explicitly stated
recommendations.root_cause: Reproducibility mentioned but idempotency per-stage not consolidated
recommendations.fix: Add to Run manifest section: 'Idempotency: RFdiffusion and ProteinMPNN are stochastic (different backbones/sequences each run unless seeds fixed); Boltz2/OpenFold3 are deterministic. Manifest captures all inputs enabling full reproducibility. For exact campaign replay, save all RFdiffusion/ProteinMPNN outputs; otherwise expect similar but not identical results from re-run.'
